---
title: "Setup"
---

Complete these steps **before** the workshop begins.

## Software

- [ ] Install [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/) (version 1.4 or later)
- [ ] Install a recent version of [RStudio](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/) or [VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/) with the Quarto extension
- [ ] (Optional) Install [R](https://cran.r-project.org/) and/or [Python](https://www.python.org/) for live code cells

## Verify your install

Run the following in a terminal to confirm Quarto is available:

```bash
quarto --version
```

## Workshop materials

- [ ] Clone the workshop repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/emilhvitfeldt/workshop-slidecrafting.git
```

## Render a test slide

- [ ] Confirm you can render a reveal.js deck

```bash
quarto render slides/01-quarto.qmd
```
